notes: Canonical asset provenance catalog. Duplicate historical rows are retained as aliases or provenanceAlternates.
Every local asset is resolved to a source page and direct download URL by scripts/sync-assets.mjs.
RuneScape Wiki game-media files are Jagex copyrighted media used by the Wiki with permission; the generated manifest preserves the file page and canonical subject page.
Skill icons have a public RS3 mirror fallback so the core set still syncs if the Wiki image API is unavailable.
Equilibrium reveal art is only sourced from official RuneScape pages; unrevealed relic/blessing art is not invented.
Second audit pass: fills catalog families that were only partially represented after the first expanded harvest.
Adds current permanent ability unlocks, missing regional bosses, activity hubs, and representative icons for major progression sets and materials.
Entries resolve through the RuneScape Wiki API; unrevealed Equilibrium art is still excluded.
Third targeted audit pass for permanent combat/account unlocks that materially change builds and are already represented in progression-unlocks.json.
Regional boss-drop families remain owned by the earlier expansion manifests; this pass avoids duplicating those rows.
Fourth targeted audit pass for current build-changing combat spells already tracked by the permanent unlock graph.
Utility Lunar spells and broad prayer/spell groups are intentionally excluded unless the planner models them individually.
Fifth targeted audit pass for region-gated or major build-changing combat prayers and curses already modeled by data/reference/prayers.json.
Basic level-only prayers, sap/leech filler tiers, and duplicate Eclipsed Soul/Divine Rage art are intentionally excluded.
Sixth targeted audit pass for permanent equipment upgrades represented directly in progression-unlocks.json.
Adds the Essence of Finality equipment anchor and the nine Zamorakian sliver enchantment consumables; recipe ingredients are intentionally excluded.
Seventh targeted audit pass for remaining concrete combat utility unlocks and ability upgrades already represented in the planner's permanent-unlock graph.
Abstract account passives, recipe ingredients, generic skilling containers and temporary consumable families are intentionally excluded.
Eighth targeted audit pass generated by comparing the live melee/ranged/magic/necromancy combat-engine source against the sourced asset manifests.
Adds named abilities/effects actually surfaced or modeled by the current combat tab; generic style basic attacks without a distinct named unlock are excluded.
Ninth targeted audit pass generated from data/combat/perks.json.
Adds the tracked current perk families still missing from assets; Ultimatums is already owned by expansion 8 and Equilibrium already exists in the base manifest.
Tenth targeted audit pass from data/combat/equipment.json.

Adds the remaining concrete named equipment/material record not already represented by a final or representative asset; generic progression-family rows are intentionally not forced into arbitrary icons.
Eleventh targeted audit pass from data/combat/abilities.json after the live style-source comparison.
Adds the two remaining distinct named Ranged abilities missing from the asset manifests.
Regional skilling activities and core tool chains. Split from the larger audit manifest to keep connector writes small and verifiable.
Thirteenth targeted audit pass from progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-outfits-2026-07-25.json.

Adds distinct gameplay activities, one representative image per meaningful skilling outfit line, and the two cross-region endgame hatchets. Existing Archaeology Guild and City of Um imagery is reused.
Fourteenth targeted audit pass from the permanent-unlock coverage index and drop-cleaner/spring-cleaner enrichment rows.
Adds concrete persistent cleaner items and the Asylum surgeon's ring; Spring cleaner recipe components and upgrade currencies are intentionally excluded.
Data browse icon gap fill: concrete inventory items, jewellery, diary T4, and permanent-unlock tools missing from public/game after the 488-file publish pass.
Skips abstract catalog packages (Kerapac progression, set families, hubs). Prefer exact RuneScape Wiki inventory File titles.
Resolver aliases for boss epithets remain UI-side work; this expansion only adds harvestable art.
Data icon batch 31: skilling outfits, archaeology tools, guild utility, focus storage.
Data icon batch 32: diary T4 rewards, Fremennik jewellery chain, travel jewellery, combat jewellery.
Data icon batch 33: places, minigames, dig sites, hunter items, activity plates for content rows.
Data icon batch 34: combat consumables, armour set representatives, weapons, invention, ability unlocks.
Data icon batch 35: more permanent unlocks, fort buildings, skilling QoL, prayer/utility.
Data icon batch 36: more weapons, armour pieces, offhands, pocket items, scripts.
Data icon batch 37: more places, fort, farm, dig sites, minigames, bosses missing art.
Data icon batch 38: consumables, bombs, prayer potions, invention components, necro tools.
Batch 39: high-value extracted subjects from remaining data gaps
Batch 40: concrete icons for remaining unresolved data labels
Hermod icon fix + Archaeology icon overhaul: prefer inventory/chathead/icon files over giant scenery screenshots for 1:1 wells.
Batch 42: bulk path-provenance registration for inventory-style icons already under public/game (and usually assets/rs3) that lack a generated-manifest path row.
fileTitle/canonicalPage/sourcePage are kebab->Title_Case wiki guesses for re-sync; verify on harvest.
Prioritizes permanent-unlocks, combat/equipment, progression, combat-utility, skilling.*. Cap 400.
Skips terrain/promo and activity-place dumps misfiled under permanent-unlocks when uncertain.
Complete a reviewed harvest with npm run sync:assets.
Bulk registration of on-disk bulk-harvest icons already under assets/rs3.
fileTitle/canonicalPage are slug guesses for re-sync; prefer re-running wiki resolve later.
Does not include public/game-only files without an assets/rs3 twin.
Expansion generated from the current app-facing combat modernisation and regional progression catalog.
Adds individual ability art, ability-codex icons, boss portraits, activity imagery and high-value progression item icons missing from the base asset manifest.
All entries are resolved through the RuneScape Wiki API by scripts/sync-assets.mjs; no generated artwork is used.
